title: Item: Custom Alchemist's Fire
content: Custom Alchemist's Fire Attack Action. Throw a flask up to 20ft. Explodes in 20ft radius. All creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw DC15 or take 4d4 Fire damage and start burning (A burning creature or object takes 1d4 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. As an action, you can extinguish fire on yourself by giving yourself the Prone condition and rolling on the ground. The fire also goes out if it is doused, submerged, or suffocated.)
